+## 3. W2-01 Foundation and binding contract
+
+Role set `cold-roles-1` is an immutable named version in `sites/binding_roles.py`; register in `ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE` and `SERVED_ROLE_SETS_BY_SITE_TYPE` (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_roles.py:17-27,117-130`). The values below are canonical. `ONE` means one binding per Site, `PER_ASSET` one per named asset. All source/device/signal rows must be registered and linked to the same Site and effective Foundation revision. No binding may silently cover two incompatible roles. Numeric normalization is IDENTITY in v1; state ENUM needs an explicit finite mapping; Celsius conversion is not implicit.
+
+| Role / asset type | Kind, unit, cardinality | Need |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `chamber_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required, one calibrated probe per `COLD_ROOM` via declared probe-to-room link |
+| `cold_policy_low`,`cold_policy_high` / `COLD_ROOM` | Foundation control number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required; low < high, same effective revision |
+| `compressor_state` / `COMPRESSOR` | point state `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, PER_ASSET | required for cooling claim |
+| `compressor_power` / `COMPRESSOR` | interval mean `kW`, PER_ASSET | optional corroboration |
+| `grid_state` / `METER` | point state `AVAILABLE|LOST`, ONE | required for outage step |
+| `backup_request`,`backup_result` / `GENERATOR` | EVENT `START_REQUEST`,`START_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | required for start-response claim |
+| `generator_state` / `GENERATOR` | point state `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, ONE | required for observed running state |
+| `backup_bus_state` / `AC_BUS` | point state `POWERED|UNPOWERED`, ONE | required for supply-to-cooling claim |
+| `transfer_result` / `TRANSFER_SWITCH` | EVENT `TRANSFER_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | optional: absent blocks switch-position claim |
+| `door_event` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT open/close, PER_ASSET | optional context |
+| `ambient_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context, never substitutes chamber probe |
+| `manual_temperature` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT manual log `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context; never silently closes a probe gap |
+
+Foundation topology uses explicit `COLD_ROOM`→`TEMPERATURE_PROBE`, `COMPRESSOR`→room, bus→compressor, generator→transfer→bus relations; every referenced asset must exist, one chamber probe cannot be primary for two rooms, and cycles/duplicate edges are refused. Policy band belongs to a room and is effective for the selected window; changing it creates a Foundation revision and binding set selection, never an in-place update. Validate finite exact positive thermal parameters, `0<=hysteresis<high-low`, probe error `>=0`, timeout `>0`, and cadence 5 minutes for the first Lab profile. Publication readiness must say **“Add a chamber temperature probe and bind its °C reading”**, **“Set a lower and upper temperature policy for this room”**, **“Bind the generator start request and result”**, or **“Transfer position is not reported; switch state is unknown”** as applicable. Configuration readiness, commissioning evidence and gateway contact remain separate (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_service.py:267-317,674-715`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:32-53`).
+
+## 4. W2-02 causal producer and publication
+
+Add `cold-thermal/1` `ModelSpec` and `cold-publication/1`; resolve frozen profile identity in `host/execution_adapter.py:113-140`, `host/lab_execution.py:1978-2015` and `simulator/assetops_simulator/kernel/execute.py:90-105` through a closed registry, with fuel/mini-grid identities preserved. Reject unknown pack/profile/parameter version before Draft. The kernel receives typed model laws and power ports, not a cold-specific branch. Lab freezes Foundation/binding IDs, scenario SHA, model/profile/observation versions and seed in run identity; Stage seals public v4 envelopes, registered Commit links publication, SQLite outbox sends authenticated Batch V2, and S2 alone creates accepted evidence (`host/lab_execution.py:2154-2164,2428-2501`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:55-66`).
+
+**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. Explicit external electrical port supplies bus power; if composing with mini-grid, use its actual port output and no duplicate generator truth.
+
+Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.
+
+`config/scenarios/cold-normal.yaml`, `cold-excursion.yaml`, `cold-backup-failed.yaml`, `cold-missing-probe.yaml`, `cold-late-reading.yaml`, `cold-contradictory.yaml` all use schema `cold-scenario/1`, 2026-10-06 19:00–20:00 UTC, seed 20417, and explicit forcing list ordered `(time,kind,asset)`; reject duplicate conflicting forcing at one instant. `cold-publication/1` channels: chamber probe `STATE_AT_INSTANT degC` every 5 minutes including end; ambient probe optional every 5; grid, generator, compressor, bus states on transition plus 5-minute heartbeat; compressor `INTERVAL_MEAN kW` per 5-minute closed-open slot; door/start/transfer/power/manual EVENT channels on transition only. All state channels map to explicit finite members and v4 mapping allowlist; no blanket forwarding. Observation profile `cold-observation/1` freezes bias, dropout intervals and latency (3 seconds by default) before Draft. Normal stays within policy and starts backup; excursion has grid loss + failed start then rising chamber temperature; backup chain success and failure variants show every observed step; missing probe drops numeric samples; late reading holds one already generated envelope and releases it later with unchanged source time; contradictory emits a second, independently sourced incompatible state at one time or an invalid role/kind mapping. Never force target mock numbers: replay assertions use observed bounds.
+
+## 5. W2-03 assessment, episodes and Findings
+
+Analytic IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. Input selection is accepted evidence only, fixed half-open `[from,to)`, explicit `known_at` cutoff on server `received_at`/decision time, effective Foundation/binding versions, and source gate. Include exact accepted IDs and SHA, configuration IDs, model version, window/cutoff in sorted basis SHA. A reading is usable only if GOOD, calibrated, mapped to the room, and clock-attested; SUSPECT is context. If two good primary readings disagree by >0.4°C at same timestamp, `CONTRADICTORY` and no point decision. Expected five-minute points: coverage = usable distinct scheduled timestamps / scheduled timestamps, capped at 1; `>=0.8` needed for an interval claim, but no gap >10 minutes may be bridged. Latest point must be <=10 minutes old at read time for a **current** state; historical window conclusion can remain bounded with explicit as-of. A failed worker or newer accepted relevant evidence marks prior projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new immutable revision is written.
+
+Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.
+
+Start chain groups by accepted `correlation_id`, generator asset and outage window. Require ordered grid LOST → START_REQUEST → START_RESULT → generator RUNNING/FAILED → optional TRANSFER_RESULT → bus POWERED/UNPOWERED → compressor state → probe response; tolerance is source-clock bound <=30 seconds for event ordering, with timeout from effective Foundation (default 5 minutes). A failed automatic start is `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with request, explicit failed result or timeout plus complete generator state coverage through timeout, and no contradictory success; missing request/result/state is `UNKNOWN_STEP`. A transfer-position claim requires accepted transfer event; bus energization alone proves only bus state. Cooling failure cannot be assigned from temperature alone. Emit claim levels `OBSERVED`, `BOUNDED`, `POSSIBLE`, `UNKNOWN`, `CONTRADICTORY`; explanations list exact missing/excluded records and claim ceiling.
+
+Episode key = SHA-256 of `(tenant,site,kind,subject room/generator asset,first accepted qualifying crossing/request event ID)`; retain anchor when late evidence adjusts boundaries, append `cold_episode_revision` and corresponding FindingRevision with transition `SUPPORT_CHANGED` or `BASIS_REFRESHED`. Two episodes split only after two stable in-band points (excursion) or a new start request (backup). If late evidence invalidates the anchor, append `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` and create a new episode with `split_from` relation; never rewrite old. Separate excursion and start-response Findings can cite the same event but share one `overlap_group` for money. Use existing S4-05 exact accepted-ID provenance and source classification (`backend/migrations/versions/0009_finding_store.py:33-87`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+## 6. W2-04 consequence, reads and UI
+
+`PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is a bounded thermal exposure indicator in `degC_min`, **not product quantity, spoilage or loss**. `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value` (currency/unit) and a product-specific reviewed `cold_exposure_rule` would be needed for a future valued risk scenario; W2 creates no default and still forbids an amount without an approved rule. `RECORDED_REPAIR` amount requires exact accepted work/cost record, currency, time and non-overlap; no such source exists in W2, so it is `UNPRICED`. All consequences pin FindingRevision, episode revision, accepted IDs, assumption revision IDs, model/formula version, source gate and overlap group. Missing/contradictory probe or policy, stale projection, mixed/unknown provenance, undeclared stock or cost → `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` with null amount. Never sum backup and excursion exposure; no zero amount as stand-in for unknown. The existing LR current-money and S4-05 source gates still apply (`backend/migrations/versions/0010_financial_assumptions.py:1-30`; `backend/migrations/versions/0011_financial_consequences.py:43-69`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).

+# W2 cold-chain technical design — 2026-10-17
+
+**Decision:** `D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-cold`. Architect contract for W2-00 and W2-01..04; Planner sequences and tests these choices. Proposed screen scope still needs owner confirmation. Existing W1 selected-window, source-label, money, Analysis and honest-gap contracts apply by reference (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:1-32`). No mock number is a stored fact.
+
+## 1. W2-00: ordinary source-to-evidence format
+
+The active authenticated path uses **SourceEnvelopeV3**, not the older staged v1/v2 envelope: v3 names record families but refuses them, while S2 also refuses non-measurements (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,77-78,240-246`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger.py:268-280`). Extend that path as schema **4**, `assetops.source-envelope`; retain v3's allocated `(gateway,source,epoch,sequence)` message identity, canonical JSON, UTC instants and exact numeric text. `source_envelope.py` v1/v2 and existing Stage artifacts remain byte-for-byte readable. The v4 parser accepts v4 only; a version dispatcher accepts v3 and v4. v3 receipts, dedup keys and accepted rows are untouched. A new publication profile pins v4; never switch an existing profile in place (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,70-78`; `simulator/assetops_simulator/gateway/mappings.py:87-107`).
+
+| v4 family / kind | Exact payload keys in addition to common v3 top-level fields | Rule |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `MEASUREMENT` | v3 payload unchanged: `family,measurement,value,unit,quality,unavailable_reason`. `STATE_AT_INSTANT` or `INTERVAL_MEAN`; cold point °C uses `degC`; state members use `state`; power mean `kW`. | No new measurement class. Null value only with `UNAVAILABLE`; `SUSPECT` excluded from assertions. |
+| `EVENT` / `DOOR_OPEN`, `DOOR_CLOSE`, `START_REQUEST`, `START_RESULT`, `TRANSFER_RESULT`, `POWER_LOSS`, `POWER_RESTORED`, `MANUAL_LOG` | `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,component_id,actor,outcome,unit,value,quality`. `event_id` and `correlation_id` required identifiers; `component_id` required except Site power events; `actor` = `CONTROLLER`,`SENSOR`,`OPERATOR`; `outcome` = `REQUESTED`,`SUCCEEDED`,`FAILED`,`OPEN`,`CLOSED`,`LOST`,`RESTORED`,`OBSERVED`,`UNKNOWN`, constrained per kind; `unit/value` either both null or a permitted quantitative pair (manual log `degC` only); `quality` = `GOOD` or `SUSPECT`. | An event is a witnessed public observation, not private disturbance truth. `MANUAL_LOG` needs registered operator source and stays contextual unless calibrated to the probe role. |
+| `EVENT` / `EV_SESSION_START`, `EV_SESSION_END`, `EV_SESSION_ABORT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_FAULT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_CLEAR` | Same keys plus `session_id,connector_id`; both required for session kinds, `connector_id` required for fault/clear and `session_id` nullable there. `outcome` = `STARTED`,`COMPLETED`,`ABORTED`,`FAULTED`,`CLEARED`; `value/unit` null. | Session identity scoped to `(tenant,site,charger asset,connector asset,session_id)`; no vehicle/customer identity. |
+
+Every v4 top-level object keeps the v3 exact keys; `message` keeps `message_id,sequence_epoch,sequence`, `source` and `mapping` keep v3 keys, `timing` keeps `source_time,published_at,interval_start,interval_end`. Events require null interval bounds; their source time is the observed transition, not a duration. For cold event `correlation_id` is the controller outage/attempt ID; a door pair shares its door-cycle ID. For EV, `correlation_id=session_id` on session events and optional registered fault episode ID on fault/clear. `event_id` is stable under retransmission and unique within `(site,source,record_kind)`; message ID remains transport identity. Canonical event payload contains explicit nulls for inapplicable fields. No arbitrary JSON detail, free text, Lab run ID, oracle, private cause, or stock identity. Event IDs generated from frozen scenario + public device channel + transition ordinal in Lab; physical adapters preserve vendor stable event ID or derive a documented hash from raw immutable event key. Cross-source event correlation is a claim input, never an acceptance dedup key.
+
+| Boundary | Exact change / refusal |
+| --- | --- |
+| Parser and mapper | Add `source_envelope_v4.py` and golden vectors; keep v3 code frozen. Extend mapping entry with `allowed_record_kinds`, `allowed_outcomes`, `requires_correlation`, `requires_session`, `allowed_units`; v3 mapping snapshots parse without these keys. New `simulator-lab-gateway-cold` v1 only allows the channel list in §4. Refuse `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`, `MISSING_FIELD`, `UNKNOWN_FIELD`, `WRONG_TYPE`, `INVALID_IDENTITY`, `INVALID_TIMING`, `INVALID_PAYLOAD`, `NOT_CANONICAL`, `MAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE`, `UNIT_INCOMPATIBLE`, `RECORD_KIND_UNSUPPORTED`, `CORRELATION_INVALID`. A v4 kind under v3 is `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`. |
+| S2 intake | Dispatch by stated schema only; validate auth scope, pinned binding revision, role/asset/kind/unit and source time within Foundation/binding validity before accept. Same message ID + same SHA returns duplicate disposition; same message ID + different SHA is `MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT`; a second `(site,source,record_kind,event_id)` with different SHA is `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT` and quarantined; identical event under a new message ID is duplicate event, not a second accepted fact. Contradictory distinct events remain accepted but lower analytic capability. Receipt V2 counts and ordinal dispositions remain stable (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger_service.py:79-167`; `backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`). |
+| Accepted storage/read | `accepted_evidence.family` becomes `MEASUREMENT|EVENT`; for EVENT, `measurement,conversion_kind` become nullable, while event quality remains `GOOD|SUSPECT`; original/normalized value and unit null unless quantitative manual log. Typed event columns store identity/kind/correlation/actor/outcome, not merely envelope JSON. Keep exact `envelope_text`, SHA, accepted-as Foundation/binding, received/published/source times and S4-05 publication lineage. `/evidence/records` adds `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,session_id,connector_id,outcome` and family/kind filters; old records serialize nulls. No event is converted into a fake state reading (`backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:54-59`). |

+## 3. W2-01 Foundation and binding contract
+
+Role set `cold-roles-1` is an immutable named version in `sites/binding_roles.py`; register in `ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE` and `SERVED_ROLE_SETS_BY_SITE_TYPE` (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_roles.py:17-27,117-130`). The values below are canonical. `ONE` means one binding per Site, `PER_ASSET` one per named asset. All source/device/signal rows must be registered and linked to the same Site and effective Foundation revision. No binding may silently cover two incompatible roles. Numeric normalization is IDENTITY in v1; state ENUM needs an explicit finite mapping; Celsius conversion is not implicit.
+
+| Role / asset type | Kind, unit, cardinality | Need |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `chamber_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required, one calibrated probe per `COLD_ROOM` via declared probe-to-room link |
+| `cold_policy_low`,`cold_policy_high` / `COLD_ROOM` | Foundation control number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required; low < high, same effective revision |
+| `compressor_state` / `COMPRESSOR` | point state `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, PER_ASSET | required for cooling claim |
+| `compressor_power` / `COMPRESSOR` | interval mean `kW`, PER_ASSET | optional corroboration |
+| `grid_state` / `METER` | point state `AVAILABLE|LOST`, ONE | required for outage step |
+| `backup_request`,`backup_result` / `GENERATOR` | EVENT `START_REQUEST`,`START_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | required for start-response claim |
+| `generator_state` / `GENERATOR` | point state `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, ONE | required for observed running state |
+| `backup_bus_state` / `AC_BUS` | point state `POWERED|UNPOWERED`, ONE | required for supply-to-cooling claim |
+| `transfer_result` / `TRANSFER_SWITCH` | EVENT `TRANSFER_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | optional: absent blocks switch-position claim |
+| `door_event` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT open/close, PER_ASSET | optional context |
+| `ambient_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context, never substitutes chamber probe |
+| `manual_temperature` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT manual log `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context; never silently closes a probe gap |
+
+Foundation topology uses explicit `COLD_ROOM`→`TEMPERATURE_PROBE`, `COMPRESSOR`→room, bus→compressor, generator→transfer→bus relations; every referenced asset must exist, one chamber probe cannot be primary for two rooms, and cycles/duplicate edges are refused. Policy band belongs to a room and is effective for the selected window; changing it creates a Foundation revision and binding set selection, never an in-place update. Validate finite exact positive thermal parameters, `0<=hysteresis<high-low`, probe error `>=0`, timeout `>0`, and cadence 5 minutes for the first Lab profile. Publication readiness must say **“Add a chamber temperature probe and bind its °C reading”**, **“Set a lower and upper temperature policy for this room”**, **“Bind the generator start request and result”**, or **“Transfer position is not reported; switch state is unknown”** as applicable. Configuration readiness, commissioning evidence and gateway contact remain separate (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_service.py:267-317,674-715`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:32-53`).

+## 4. W2-02 causal producer and publication
+
+Add `cold-thermal/1` `ModelSpec` and `cold-publication/1`; resolve frozen profile identity in `host/execution_adapter.py:113-140`, `host/lab_execution.py:1978-2015` and `simulator/assetops_simulator/kernel/execute.py:90-105` through a closed registry, with fuel/mini-grid identities preserved. Reject unknown pack/profile/parameter version before Draft. The kernel receives typed model laws and power ports, not a cold-specific branch. Lab freezes Foundation/binding IDs, scenario SHA, model/profile/observation versions and seed in run identity; Stage seals public v4 envelopes, registered Commit links publication, SQLite outbox sends authenticated Batch V2, and S2 alone creates accepted evidence (`host/lab_execution.py:2154-2164,2428-2501`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:55-66`).
+
+**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. Explicit external electrical port supplies bus power; if composing with mini-grid, use its actual port output and no duplicate generator truth.
+
+Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.
+
+`config/scenarios/cold-normal.yaml`, `cold-excursion.yaml`, `cold-backup-failed.yaml`, `cold-missing-probe.yaml`, `cold-late-reading.yaml`, `cold-contradictory.yaml` all use schema `cold-scenario/1`, 2026-10-06 19:00–20:00 UTC, seed 20417, and explicit forcing list ordered `(time,kind,asset)`; reject duplicate conflicting forcing at one instant. `cold-publication/1` channels: chamber probe `STATE_AT_INSTANT degC` every 5 minutes including end; ambient probe optional every 5; grid, generator, compressor, bus states on transition plus 5-minute heartbeat; compressor `INTERVAL_MEAN kW` per 5-minute closed-open slot; door/start/transfer/power/manual EVENT channels on transition only. All state channels map to explicit finite members and v4 mapping allowlist; no blanket forwarding. Observation profile `cold-observation/1` freezes bias, dropout intervals and latency (3 seconds by default) before Draft. Normal stays within policy and starts backup; excursion has grid loss + failed start then rising chamber temperature; backup chain success and failure variants show every observed step; missing probe drops numeric samples; late reading holds one already generated envelope and releases it later with unchanged source time; contradictory emits a second, independently sourced incompatible state at one time or an invalid role/kind mapping. Never force target mock numbers: replay assertions use observed bounds.
+
+## 5. W2-03 assessment, episodes and Findings
+
+Analytic IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. Input selection is accepted evidence only, fixed half-open `[from,to)`, explicit `known_at` cutoff on server `received_at`/decision time, effective Foundation/binding versions, and source gate. Include exact accepted IDs and SHA, configuration IDs, model version, window/cutoff in sorted basis SHA. A reading is usable only if GOOD, calibrated, mapped to the room, and clock-attested; SUSPECT is context. If two good primary readings disagree by >0.4°C at same timestamp, `CONTRADICTORY` and no point decision. Expected five-minute points: coverage = usable distinct scheduled timestamps / scheduled timestamps, capped at 1; `>=0.8` needed for an interval claim, but no gap >10 minutes may be bridged. Latest point must be <=10 minutes old at read time for a **current** state; historical window conclusion can remain bounded with explicit as-of. A failed worker or newer accepted relevant evidence marks prior projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new immutable revision is written.
+
+Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.
+
+Start chain groups by accepted `correlation_id`, generator asset and outage window. Require ordered grid LOST → START_REQUEST → START_RESULT → generator RUNNING/FAILED → optional TRANSFER_RESULT → bus POWERED/UNPOWERED → compressor state → probe response; tolerance is source-clock bound <=30 seconds for event ordering, with timeout from effective Foundation (default 5 minutes). A failed automatic start is `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with request, explicit failed result or timeout plus complete generator state coverage through timeout, and no contradictory success; missing request/result/state is `UNKNOWN_STEP`. A transfer-position claim requires accepted transfer event; bus energization alone proves only bus state. Cooling failure cannot be assigned from temperature alone. Emit claim levels `OBSERVED`, `BOUNDED`, `POSSIBLE`, `UNKNOWN`, `CONTRADICTORY`; explanations list exact missing/excluded records and claim ceiling.
+
+Episode key = SHA-256 of `(tenant,site,kind,subject room/generator asset,first accepted qualifying crossing/request event ID)`; retain anchor when late evidence adjusts boundaries, append `cold_episode_revision` and corresponding FindingRevision with transition `SUPPORT_CHANGED` or `BASIS_REFRESHED`. Two episodes split only after two stable in-band points (excursion) or a new start request (backup). If late evidence invalidates the anchor, append `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` and create a new episode with `split_from` relation; never rewrite old. Separate excursion and start-response Findings can cite the same event but share one `overlap_group` for money. Use existing S4-05 exact accepted-ID provenance and source classification (`backend/migrations/versions/0009_finding_store.py:33-87`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+## 6. W2-04 consequence, reads and UI
+
+`PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is a bounded thermal exposure indicator in `degC_min`, **not product quantity, spoilage or loss**. `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value` (currency/unit) and a product-specific reviewed `cold_exposure_rule` would be needed for a future valued risk scenario; W2 creates no default and still forbids an amount without an approved rule. `RECORDED_REPAIR` amount requires exact accepted work/cost record, currency, time and non-overlap; no such source exists in W2, so it is `UNPRICED`. All consequences pin FindingRevision, episode revision, accepted IDs, assumption revision IDs, model/formula version, source gate and overlap group. Missing/contradictory probe or policy, stale projection, mixed/unknown provenance, undeclared stock or cost → `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` with null amount. Never sum backup and excursion exposure; no zero amount as stand-in for unknown. The existing LR current-money and S4-05 source gates still apply (`backend/migrations/versions/0010_financial_assumptions.py:1-30`; `backend/migrations/versions/0011_financial_consequences.py:43-69`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+All routes below use Site code, authenticated tenant scope, UTC `from,to` (end exclusive), optional UTC `known_at` (default current committed watermark), max 31-day window, and return `{site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance,limitations,...}`. `watermark` is latest included ingestion disposition `decided_at` plus assessment revision ID; a selected historical cutoff cannot claim today's currentness. Lists use opaque `(time,id)` cursor, `limit` default 50 max 200 and `{items,next_cursor}`. Shared refusal envelope `{error:{code,message}}`: 401 unauthenticated, 403 wrong tenant/source-gated disclosure, 404 Site/record not found or wrong type, 409 unresolved selected revision or recompute conflict, 422 malformed/window/range/unknown parameter, 503 ledger/projection unavailable; a valid missing claim returns 200 with `UNKNOWN`/null, never 404 or a fabricated zero. Existing evidence/Finding paths continue to serve exact links (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:157-161`; `backend/assetops_backend/finding_api.py:102-189`).

+# W2 cold-chain technical design — 2026-10-17
+
+**Decision:** `D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-cold`. Architect contract for W2-00 and W2-01..04; Planner sequences and tests these choices. Proposed screen scope still needs owner confirmation. Existing W1 selected-window, source-label, money, Analysis and honest-gap contracts apply by reference (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:1-32`). No mock number is a stored fact.
+
+## 1. W2-00: ordinary source-to-evidence format
+
+The active authenticated path uses **SourceEnvelopeV3**, not the older staged v1/v2 envelope: v3 names record families but refuses them, while S2 also refuses non-measurements (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,77-78,240-246`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger.py:268-280`). Extend that path as schema **4**, `assetops.source-envelope`; retain v3's allocated `(gateway,source,epoch,sequence)` message identity, canonical JSON, UTC instants and exact numeric text. `source_envelope.py` v1/v2 and existing Stage artifacts remain byte-for-byte readable. The v4 parser accepts v4 only; a version dispatcher accepts v3 and v4. v3 receipts, dedup keys and accepted rows are untouched. A new publication profile pins v4; never switch an existing profile in place (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,70-78`; `simulator/assetops_simulator/gateway/mappings.py:87-107`).
+
+| v4 family / kind | Exact payload keys in addition to common v3 top-level fields | Rule |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `MEASUREMENT` | v3 payload unchanged: `family,measurement,value,unit,quality,unavailable_reason`. `STATE_AT_INSTANT` or `INTERVAL_MEAN`; cold point °C uses `degC`; state members use `state`; power mean `kW`. | No new measurement class. Null value only with `UNAVAILABLE`; `SUSPECT` excluded from assertions. |
+| `EVENT` / `DOOR_OPEN`, `DOOR_CLOSE`, `START_REQUEST`, `START_RESULT`, `TRANSFER_RESULT`, `POWER_LOSS`, `POWER_RESTORED`, `MANUAL_LOG` | `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,component_id,actor,outcome,unit,value,quality`. `event_id` and `correlation_id` required identifiers; `component_id` required except Site power events; `actor` = `CONTROLLER`,`SENSOR`,`OPERATOR`; `outcome` = `REQUESTED`,`SUCCEEDED`,`FAILED`,`OPEN`,`CLOSED`,`LOST`,`RESTORED`,`OBSERVED`,`UNKNOWN`, constrained per kind; `unit/value` either both null or a permitted quantitative pair (manual log `degC` only); `quality` = `GOOD` or `SUSPECT`. | An event is a witnessed public observation, not private disturbance truth. `MANUAL_LOG` needs registered operator source and stays contextual unless calibrated to the probe role. |
+| `EVENT` / `EV_SESSION_START`, `EV_SESSION_END`, `EV_SESSION_ABORT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_FAULT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_CLEAR` | Same keys plus `session_id,connector_id`; both required for session kinds, `connector_id` required for fault/clear and `session_id` nullable there. `outcome` = `STARTED`,`COMPLETED`,`ABORTED`,`FAULTED`,`CLEARED`; `value/unit` null. | Session identity scoped to `(tenant,site,charger asset,connector asset,session_id)`; no vehicle/customer identity. |
+
+Kind-to-outcome allowlist is exact: `DOOR_OPEN→OPEN`, `DOOR_CLOSE→CLOSED`, `START_REQUEST→REQUESTED`, `START_RESULT→SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `TRANSFER_RESULT→SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `POWER_LOSS→LOST`, `POWER_RESTORED→RESTORED`, `MANUAL_LOG→OBSERVED`, `EV_SESSION_START→STARTED`, `EV_SESSION_END→COMPLETED`, `EV_SESSION_ABORT→ABORTED`, `EV_CONNECTOR_FAULT→FAULTED`, `EV_CONNECTOR_CLEAR→CLEARED`. All other pairs refuse `INVALID_PAYLOAD`. `MANUAL_LOG` requires value/`degC`; every other event requires both null. A record kind with no `session_id` still carries the key as null; `connector_id` is likewise explicit null for cold events.
+
+Every v4 top-level object keeps the v3 exact keys; `message` keeps `message_id,sequence_epoch,sequence`, `source` and `mapping` keep v3 keys, `timing` keeps `source_time,published_at,interval_start,interval_end`. Events require null interval bounds; their source time is the observed transition, not a duration. For cold event `correlation_id` is the controller outage/attempt ID; a door pair shares its door-cycle ID. For EV, `correlation_id=session_id` on session events and optional registered fault episode ID on fault/clear. `event_id` is stable under retransmission and unique within `(site,source,record_kind)`; message ID remains transport identity. Canonical event payload contains explicit nulls for inapplicable fields. No arbitrary JSON detail, free text, Lab run ID, oracle, private cause, or stock identity. Event IDs generated from frozen scenario + public device channel + transition ordinal in Lab; physical adapters preserve vendor stable event ID or derive a documented hash from raw immutable event key. Cross-source event correlation is a claim input, never an acceptance dedup key.
+
+| Boundary | Exact change / refusal |
+| --- | --- |
+| Parser and mapper | Add `source_envelope_v4.py` and golden vectors; keep v3 code frozen. Extend mapping entry with `allowed_record_kinds`, `allowed_outcomes`, `requires_correlation`, `requires_session`, `allowed_units`; v3 mapping snapshots parse without these keys. New `simulator-lab-gateway-cold` v1 only allows the channel list in §4. Refuse `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`, `MISSING_FIELD`, `UNKNOWN_FIELD`, `WRONG_TYPE`, `INVALID_IDENTITY`, `INVALID_TIMING`, `INVALID_PAYLOAD`, `NOT_CANONICAL`, `MAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE`, `UNIT_INCOMPATIBLE`, `RECORD_KIND_UNSUPPORTED`, `CORRELATION_INVALID`. A v4 kind under v3 is `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`. |
+| S2 intake | Dispatch by stated schema only; validate auth scope, pinned binding revision, role/asset/kind/unit and source time within Foundation/binding validity before accept. Same message ID + same SHA returns duplicate disposition; same message ID + different SHA is `MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT`; a second `(site,source,record_kind,event_id)` with different SHA is `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT` and quarantined; identical event under a new message ID is duplicate event, not a second accepted fact. Contradictory distinct events remain accepted but lower analytic capability. Receipt V2 counts and ordinal dispositions remain stable (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger_service.py:79-167`; `backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`). |
+| Accepted storage/read | `accepted_evidence.family` becomes `MEASUREMENT|EVENT`; for EVENT, `measurement,conversion_kind` become nullable, while event quality remains `GOOD|SUSPECT`; original/normalized value and unit null unless quantitative manual log. Typed event columns store identity/kind/correlation/actor/outcome, not merely envelope JSON. Keep exact `envelope_text`, SHA, accepted-as Foundation/binding, received/published/source times and S4-05 publication lineage. `/evidence/records` adds `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,session_id,connector_id,outcome` and family/kind filters; old records serialize nulls. No event is converted into a fake state reading (`backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:54-59`). |
+
+## 2. Schema and migration ledger
+
+Postgres migration head is `0019_verification_core` (`backend/migrations/versions/0019_verification_core.py:1-29`). All new rows carry `(tenant_id,site_id)` and composite same-Site FKs. Use `ledger_append_only()` for facts/revisions, and the existing S1 effective/recorded validity rules for Foundation and binding publications (`backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`; `backend/migrations/versions/0007_dispatch_assessment.py:83-125`). +## 3. W2-01 Foundation and binding contract
+
+Role set `cold-roles-1` is an immutable named version in `sites/binding_roles.py`; register in `ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE` and `SERVED_ROLE_SETS_BY_SITE_TYPE` (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_roles.py:17-27,117-130`). The values below are canonical. `ONE` means one binding per Site, `PER_ASSET` one per named asset. All source/device/signal rows must be registered and linked to the same Site and effective Foundation revision. No binding may silently cover two incompatible roles. Numeric normalization is IDENTITY in v1; state ENUM needs an explicit finite mapping; Celsius conversion is not implicit.
+
+| Role / asset type | Kind, unit, cardinality | Need |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `chamber_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required, one calibrated probe per `COLD_ROOM` via declared probe-to-room link |
+| `cold_policy_low`,`cold_policy_high` / `COLD_ROOM` | Foundation control number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required; low < high, same effective revision |
+| `compressor_state` / `COMPRESSOR` | point state `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, PER_ASSET | required for cooling claim |
+| `compressor_power` / `COMPRESSOR` | interval mean `kW`, PER_ASSET | optional corroboration |
+| `grid_state` / `METER` | point state `AVAILABLE|LOST`, ONE | required for outage step |
+| `backup_request`,`backup_result` / `GENERATOR` | EVENT `START_REQUEST`,`START_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | required for start-response claim |
+| `generator_state` / `GENERATOR` | point state `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, ONE | required for observed running state |
+| `backup_bus_state` / `AC_BUS` | point state `POWERED|UNPOWERED`, ONE | required for supply-to-cooling claim |
+| `transfer_result` / `TRANSFER_SWITCH` | EVENT `TRANSFER_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | optional: absent blocks switch-position claim |
+| `door_event` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT open/close, PER_ASSET | optional context |
+| `ambient_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context, never substitutes chamber probe |
+| `manual_temperature` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT manual log `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context; never silently closes a probe gap |
+
+Foundation topology uses explicit `COLD_ROOM`→`TEMPERATURE_PROBE`, `COMPRESSOR`→room, bus→compressor, generator→transfer→bus relations; every referenced asset must exist, one chamber probe cannot be primary for two rooms, and cycles/duplicate edges are refused. Policy band belongs to a room and is effective for the selected window; changing it creates a Foundation revision and binding set selection, never an in-place update. Validate finite exact positive thermal parameters, `0<=hysteresis<high-low`, probe error `>=0`, timeout `>0`, and cadence 5 minutes for the first Lab profile. Publication readiness must say **“Add a chamber temperature probe and bind its °C reading”**, **“Set a lower and upper temperature policy for this room”**, **“Bind the generator start request and result”**, or **“Transfer position is not reported; switch state is unknown”** as applicable. Configuration readiness, commissioning evidence and gateway contact remain separate (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_service.py:267-317,674-715`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:32-53`).
+
+## 4. W2-02 causal producer and publication
+
+Add `cold-thermal/1` `ModelSpec` and `cold-publication/1`; resolve frozen profile identity in `host/execution_adapter.py:113-140`, `host/lab_execution.py:1978-2015` and `simulator/assetops_simulator/kernel/execute.py:90-105` through a closed registry, with fuel/mini-grid identities preserved. Reject unknown pack/profile/parameter version before Draft. The kernel receives typed model laws and power ports, not a cold-specific branch. Lab freezes Foundation/binding IDs, scenario SHA, model/profile/observation versions and seed in run identity; Stage seals public v4 envelopes, registered Commit links publication, SQLite outbox sends authenticated Batch V2, and S2 alone creates accepted evidence (`host/lab_execution.py:2154-2164,2428-2501`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:55-66`).
+
+**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. Explicit external electrical port supplies bus power; if composing with mini-grid, use its actual port output and no duplicate generator truth.
+
+Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.
+
+`config/scenarios/cold-normal.yaml`, `cold-excursion.yaml`, `cold-backup-failed.yaml`, `cold-missing-probe.yaml`, `cold-late-reading.yaml`, `cold-contradictory.yaml` all use schema `cold-scenario/1`, 2026-10-06 19:00–20:00 UTC, seed 20417, and explicit forcing list ordered `(time,kind,asset)`; reject duplicate conflicting forcing at one instant. `cold-publication/1` channels: chamber probe `STATE_AT_INSTANT degC` every 5 minutes including end; ambient probe optional every 5; grid, generator, compressor, bus states on transition plus 5-minute heartbeat; compressor `INTERVAL_MEAN kW` per 5-minute closed-open slot; door/start/transfer/power/manual EVENT channels on transition only. All state channels map to explicit finite members and v4 mapping allowlist; no blanket forwarding. Observation profile `cold-observation/1` freezes bias, dropout intervals and latency (3 seconds by default) before Draft. Normal stays within policy and starts backup; excursion has grid loss + failed start then rising chamber temperature; backup chain success and failure variants show every observed step; missing probe drops numeric samples; late reading holds one already generated envelope and releases it later with unchanged source time; contradictory emits a second, independently sourced incompatible state at one time or an invalid role/kind mapping. Never force target mock numbers: replay assertions use observed bounds.
+
+The closed cold mapping uses `(device_id,signal_id)`: `(chamber-probe,temperature)` degC point, `(ambient-probe,temperature)` degC point, `(grid-meter,state)` state point, `(generator-controller,state)` state point, `(compressor-controller,state)` state point, `(backup-bus-meter,state)` state point, `(compressor-meter,power)` kW interval mean, `(door-sensor,event)` door events, `(generator-controller,start-event)` request/result events, `(transfer-controller,event)` transfer result, `(grid-meter,event)` loss/restored events, `(operator-log,temperature-event)` manual log. Each tuple is a separate versioned mapping entry with only its listed kinds, values and cadence. W2-00 also reserves EV entries `(charger-controller,session-event)` for session start/end/abort and `(connector-controller,fault-event)` for fault/clear, with connector/session identity rules above; W2-05b supplies the EV pack and its own frozen mapping version. The same signal ID on a different device is not an implicit alias (`simulator/assetops_simulator/gateway/mappings.py:22-46,87-107`).
+
+## 5. W2-03 assessment, episodes and Findings
+
+Analytic IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. Input selection is accepted evidence only, fixed half-open `[from,to)`, explicit `known_at` cutoff on server `received_at`/decision time, effective Foundation/binding versions, and source gate. Include exact accepted IDs and SHA, configuration IDs, model version, window/cutoff in sorted basis SHA. A reading is usable only if GOOD, calibrated, mapped to the room, and clock-attested; SUSPECT is context. If two good primary readings disagree by >0.4°C at same timestamp, `CONTRADICTORY` and no point decision. Expected five-minute points: coverage = usable distinct scheduled timestamps / scheduled timestamps, capped at 1; `>=0.8` needed for an interval claim, but no gap >10 minutes may be bridged. Latest point must be <=10 minutes old at read time for a **current** state; historical window conclusion can remain bounded with explicit as-of. A failed worker or newer accepted relevant evidence marks prior projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new immutable revision is written.
+
+Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.
+
+Start chain groups by accepted `correlation_id`, generator asset and outage window. Require ordered grid LOST → START_REQUEST → START_RESULT → generator RUNNING/FAILED → optional TRANSFER_RESULT → bus POWERED/UNPOWERED → compressor state → probe response; tolerance is source-clock bound <=30 seconds for event ordering, with timeout from effective Foundation (default 5 minutes). A failed automatic start is `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with request, explicit failed result or timeout plus complete generator state coverage through timeout, and no contradictory success; missing request/result/state is `UNKNOWN_STEP`. A transfer-position claim requires accepted transfer event; bus energization alone proves only bus state. Cooling failure cannot be assigned from temperature alone. Emit claim levels `OBSERVED`, `BOUNDED`, `POSSIBLE`, `UNKNOWN`, `CONTRADICTORY`; explanations list exact missing/excluded records and claim ceiling.
+
+Episode key = SHA-256 of `(tenant,site,kind,subject room/generator asset,first accepted qualifying crossing/request event ID)`; retain anchor when late evidence adjusts boundaries, append `cold_episode_revision` and corresponding FindingRevision with transition `SUPPORT_CHANGED` or `BASIS_REFRESHED`. Two episodes split only after two stable in-band points (excursion) or a new start request (backup). If late evidence invalidates the anchor, append `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` and create a new episode with `split_from` relation; never rewrite old. Separate excursion and start-response Findings can cite the same event but share one `overlap_group` for money. Use existing S4-05 exact accepted-ID provenance and source classification (`backend/migrations/versions/0009_finding_store.py:33-87`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+## 6. W2-04 consequence, reads and UI
+
+`PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is a bounded thermal exposure indicator in `degC_min`, **not product quantity, spoilage or loss**. `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value` (currency/unit) and a product-specific reviewed `cold_exposure_rule` would be needed for a future valued risk scenario; W2 creates no default and still forbids an amount without an approved rule. `RECORDED_REPAIR` amount requires exact accepted work/cost record, currency, time and non-overlap; no such source exists in W2, so it is `UNPRICED`. All consequences pin FindingRevision, episode revision, accepted IDs, assumption revision IDs, model/formula version, source gate and overlap group. Missing/contradictory probe or policy, stale projection, mixed/unknown provenance, undeclared stock or cost → `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` with null amount. Never sum backup and excursion exposure; no zero amount as stand-in for unknown. The existing LR current-money and S4-05 source gates still apply (`backend/migrations/versions/0010_financial_assumptions.py:1-30`; `backend/migrations/versions/0011_financial_consequences.py:43-69`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+All routes below use Site code, authenticated tenant scope, UTC `from,to` (end exclusive), optional UTC `known_at` (default current committed watermark), max 31-day window, and return `{site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance,limitations,...}`. `watermark` is latest included ingestion disposition `decided_at` plus assessment revision ID; a selected historical cutoff cannot claim today's currentness. Lists use opaque `(time,id)` cursor, `limit` default 50 max 200 and `{items,next_cursor}`. Shared refusal envelope `{error:{code,message}}`: 401 unauthenticated, 403 wrong tenant/source-gated disclosure, 404 Site/record not found or wrong type, 409 unresolved selected revision or recompute conflict, 422 malformed/window/range/unknown parameter, 503 ledger/projection unavailable; a valid missing claim returns 200 with `UNKNOWN`/null, never 404 or a fabricated zero. Existing evidence/Finding paths continue to serve exact links (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:157-161`; `backend/assetops_backend/finding_api.py:102-189`).

+# W2 cold-chain technical design — 2026-10-17
+
+**Decision:** `D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-cold`. Architect contract for W2-00 and W2-01..04; Planner sequences and tests these choices. Proposed screen scope still needs owner confirmation. Existing W1 selected-window, source-label, money, Analysis and honest-gap contracts apply by reference (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:1-32`). No mock number is a stored fact.
+
+## 1. W2-00: ordinary source-to-evidence format
+
+The active authenticated path uses **SourceEnvelopeV3**, not the older staged v1/v2 envelope: v3 names record families but refuses them, while S2 also refuses non-measurements (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,77-78,240-246`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger.py:268-280`). Extend that path as schema **4**, `assetops.source-envelope`; retain v3's allocated `(gateway,source,epoch,sequence)` message identity, canonical JSON, UTC instants and exact numeric text. `source_envelope.py` v1/v2 and existing Stage artifacts remain byte-for-byte readable. The v4 parser accepts v4 only; a version dispatcher accepts v3 and v4. v3 receipts, dedup keys and accepted rows are untouched. A new publication profile pins v4; never switch an existing profile in place (`contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v3.py:1-43,70-78`; `simulator/assetops_simulator/gateway/mappings.py:87-107`).
+
+| v4 family / kind | Exact payload keys in addition to common v3 top-level fields | Rule |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `MEASUREMENT` | v3 payload unchanged: `family,measurement,value,unit,quality,unavailable_reason`. `STATE_AT_INSTANT` or `INTERVAL_MEAN`; cold point °C uses `degC`; state members use `state`; power mean `kW`. | No new measurement class. Null value only with `UNAVAILABLE`; `SUSPECT` excluded from assertions. |
+| `EVENT` / `DOOR_OPEN`, `DOOR_CLOSE`, `START_REQUEST`, `START_RESULT`, `TRANSFER_RESULT`, `POWER_LOSS`, `POWER_RESTORED`, `MANUAL_LOG` | `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,component_id,actor,outcome,unit,value,quality`. `event_id` and `correlation_id` required identifiers; `component_id` required except Site power events; `actor` = `CONTROLLER`,`SENSOR`,`OPERATOR`; `outcome` = `REQUESTED`,`SUCCEEDED`,`FAILED`,`OPEN`,`CLOSED`,`LOST`,`RESTORED`,`OBSERVED`,`UNKNOWN`, constrained per kind; `unit/value` either both null or a permitted quantitative pair (manual log `degC` only); `quality` = `GOOD` or `SUSPECT`. | An event is a witnessed public observation, not private disturbance truth. `MANUAL_LOG` needs registered operator source and stays contextual unless calibrated to the probe role. |
+| `EVENT` / `EV_SESSION_START`, `EV_SESSION_END`, `EV_SESSION_ABORT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_FAULT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_CLEAR` | Same keys plus `session_id,connector_id`; both required for session kinds, `connector_id` required for fault/clear and `session_id` nullable there. `outcome` = `STARTED`,`COMPLETED`,`ABORTED`,`FAULTED`,`CLEARED`; `value/unit` null. | Session identity scoped to `(tenant,site,charger asset,connector asset,session_id)`; no vehicle/customer identity. |
+
+Kind-to-outcome allowlist is exact: `DOOR_OPEN→OPEN`, `DOOR_CLOSE→CLOSED`, `START_REQUEST→REQUESTED`, `START_RESULT→SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `TRANSFER_RESULT→SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `POWER_LOSS→LOST`, `POWER_RESTORED→RESTORED`, `MANUAL_LOG→OBSERVED`, `EV_SESSION_START→STARTED`, `EV_SESSION_END→COMPLETED`, `EV_SESSION_ABORT→ABORTED`, `EV_CONNECTOR_FAULT→FAULTED`, `EV_CONNECTOR_CLEAR→CLEARED`. All other pairs refuse `INVALID_PAYLOAD`. `MANUAL_LOG` requires value/`degC`; every other event requires both null. A record kind with no `session_id` still carries the key as null; `connector_id` is likewise explicit null for cold events.
+
+Every v4 top-level object keeps the v3 exact keys; `message` keeps `message_id,sequence_epoch,sequence`, `source` and `mapping` keep v3 keys, `timing` keeps `source_time,published_at,interval_start,interval_end`. Events require null interval bounds; their source time is the observed transition, not a duration. For cold event `correlation_id` is the controller outage/attempt ID; a door pair shares its door-cycle ID. For EV, `correlation_id=session_id` on session events and optional registered fault episode ID on fault/clear. `event_id` is stable under retransmission and unique within `(site,source,record_kind)`; message ID remains transport identity. Canonical event payload contains explicit nulls for inapplicable fields. No arbitrary JSON detail, free text, Lab run ID, oracle, private cause, or stock identity. Event IDs generated from frozen scenario + public device channel + transition ordinal in Lab; physical adapters preserve vendor stable event ID or derive a documented hash from raw immutable event key. Cross-source event correlation is a claim input, never an acceptance dedup key.
+
+| Boundary | Exact change / refusal |
+| --- | --- |
+| Parser and mapper | Add `source_envelope_v4.py` and golden vectors; keep v3 code frozen. Extend mapping entry with `allowed_record_kinds`, `allowed_outcomes`, `requires_correlation`, `requires_session`, `allowed_units`; v3 mapping snapshots parse without these keys. New `simulator-lab-gateway-cold` v1 only allows the channel list in §4. Refuse `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`, `MISSING_FIELD`, `UNKNOWN_FIELD`, `WRONG_TYPE`, `INVALID_IDENTITY`, `INVALID_TIMING`, `INVALID_PAYLOAD`, `NOT_CANONICAL`, `MAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE`, `UNIT_INCOMPATIBLE`, `RECORD_KIND_UNSUPPORTED`, `CORRELATION_INVALID`. A v4 kind under v3 is `SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`. |
+| S2 intake | Dispatch by stated schema only; validate auth scope, pinned binding revision, role/asset/kind/unit and source time within Foundation/binding validity before accept. Same message ID + same SHA returns duplicate disposition; same message ID + different SHA is `MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT`; a second `(site,source,record_kind,event_id)` with different SHA is `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT` and quarantined; identical event under a new message ID is duplicate event, not a second accepted fact. Contradictory distinct events remain accepted but lower analytic capability. Receipt V2 counts and ordinal dispositions remain stable (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence/ledger_service.py:79-167`; `backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`). |
+| Accepted storage/read | `accepted_evidence.family` becomes `MEASUREMENT|EVENT`; for EVENT, `measurement,conversion_kind` become nullable, while event quality remains `GOOD|SUSPECT`; original/normalized value and unit null unless quantitative manual log. Typed event columns store identity/kind/correlation/actor/outcome, not merely envelope JSON. Keep exact `envelope_text`, SHA, accepted-as Foundation/binding, received/published/source times and S4-05 publication lineage. `/evidence/records` adds `family,record_kind,event_id,correlation_id,session_id,connector_id,outcome` and family/kind filters; old records serialize nulls. No event is converted into a fake state reading (`backend/migrations/versions/0005_evidence_ledger.py:161-216`; `backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:54-59`). |

+## 3. W2-01 Foundation and binding contract
+
+Role set `cold-roles-1` is an immutable named version in `sites/binding_roles.py`; register in `ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE` and `SERVED_ROLE_SETS_BY_SITE_TYPE` (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_roles.py:17-27,117-130`). The values below are canonical. `ONE` means one binding per Site, `PER_ASSET` one per named asset. All source/device/signal rows must be registered and linked to the same Site and effective Foundation revision. No binding may silently cover two incompatible roles. Numeric normalization is IDENTITY in v1; state ENUM needs an explicit finite mapping; Celsius conversion is not implicit.
+
+| Role / asset type | Kind, unit, cardinality | Need |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `chamber_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required, one calibrated probe per `COLD_ROOM` via declared probe-to-room link |
+| `cold_policy_low`,`cold_policy_high` / `COLD_ROOM` | Foundation control number `degC`, PER_ASSET | required; low < high, same effective revision |
+| `compressor_state` / `COMPRESSOR` | point state `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, PER_ASSET | required for cooling claim |
+| `compressor_power` / `COMPRESSOR` | interval mean `kW`, PER_ASSET | optional corroboration |
+| `grid_state` / `METER` | point state `AVAILABLE|LOST`, ONE | required for outage step |
+| `backup_request`,`backup_result` / `GENERATOR` | EVENT `START_REQUEST`,`START_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | required for start-response claim |
+| `generator_state` / `GENERATOR` | point state `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, ONE | required for observed running state |
+| `backup_bus_state` / `AC_BUS` | point state `POWERED|UNPOWERED`, ONE | required for supply-to-cooling claim |
+| `transfer_result` / `TRANSFER_SWITCH` | EVENT `TRANSFER_RESULT`, ONE per attempt | optional: absent blocks switch-position claim |
+| `door_event` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT open/close, PER_ASSET | optional context |
+| `ambient_temperature` / `TEMPERATURE_PROBE` | point number `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context, never substitutes chamber probe |
+| `manual_temperature` / `COLD_ROOM` | EVENT manual log `degC`, PER_ASSET | optional context; never silently closes a probe gap |
+
+Foundation topology uses explicit `COLD_ROOM`→`TEMPERATURE_PROBE`, `COMPRESSOR`→room, bus→compressor, generator→transfer→bus relations; every referenced asset must exist, one chamber probe cannot be primary for two rooms, and cycles/duplicate edges are refused. Policy band belongs to a room and is effective for the selected window; changing it creates a Foundation revision and binding set selection, never an in-place update. Validate finite exact positive thermal parameters, `0<=hysteresis<high-low`, probe error `>=0`, timeout `>0`, and cadence 5 minutes for the first Lab profile. Publication readiness must say **“Add a chamber temperature probe and bind its °C reading”**, **“Set a lower and upper temperature policy for this room”**, **“Bind the generator start request and result”**, or **“Transfer position is not reported; switch state is unknown”** as applicable. Configuration readiness, commissioning evidence and gateway contact remain separate (`backend/assetops_backend/sites/binding_service.py:267-317,674-715`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:32-53`).
+
+## 4. W2-02 causal producer and publication
+
+Add `cold-thermal/1` `ModelSpec` and `cold-publication/1`; resolve frozen profile identity in `host/execution_adapter.py:113-140`, `host/lab_execution.py:1978-2015` and `simulator/assetops_simulator/kernel/execute.py:90-105` through a closed registry, with fuel/mini-grid identities preserved. Reject unknown pack/profile/parameter version before Draft. The kernel receives typed model laws and power ports, not a cold-specific branch. Lab freezes Foundation/binding IDs, scenario SHA, model/profile/observation versions and seed in run identity; Stage seals public v4 envelopes, registered Commit links publication, SQLite outbox sends authenticated Batch V2, and S2 alone creates accepted evidence (`host/lab_execution.py:2154-2164,2428-2501`; `.agent/architect-W2-design.md:55-66`).
+
+**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. Explicit external electrical port supplies bus power; if composing with mini-grid, use its actual port output and no duplicate generator truth.
+
+Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.
+
+`config/scenarios/cold-normal.yaml`, `cold-excursion.yaml`, `cold-backup-failed.yaml`, `cold-missing-probe.yaml`, `cold-late-reading.yaml`, `cold-contradictory.yaml` all use schema `cold-scenario/1`, 2026-10-06 19:00–20:00 UTC, seed 20417, and explicit forcing list ordered `(time,kind,asset)`; reject duplicate conflicting forcing at one instant. `cold-publication/1` channels: chamber probe `STATE_AT_INSTANT degC` every 5 minutes including end; ambient probe optional every 5; grid, generator, compressor, bus states on transition plus 5-minute heartbeat; compressor `INTERVAL_MEAN kW` per 5-minute closed-open slot; door/start/transfer/power/manual EVENT channels on transition only. All state channels map to explicit finite members and v4 mapping allowlist; no blanket forwarding. Observation profile `cold-observation/1` freezes bias, dropout intervals and latency (3 seconds by default) before Draft. Normal stays within policy and starts backup; excursion has grid loss + failed start then rising chamber temperature; backup chain success and failure variants show every observed step; missing probe drops numeric samples; late reading holds one already generated envelope and releases it later with unchanged source time; contradictory emits a second, independently sourced incompatible state at one time or an invalid role/kind mapping. Never force target mock numbers: replay assertions use observed bounds.
+
+The closed cold mapping uses `(device_id,signal_id)`: `(chamber-probe,temperature)` degC point, `(ambient-probe,temperature)` degC point, `(grid-meter,state)` state point, `(generator-controller,state)` state point, `(compressor-controller,state)` state point, `(backup-bus-meter,state)` state point, `(compressor-meter,power)` kW interval mean, `(door-sensor,event)` door events, `(generator-controller,start-event)` request/result events, `(transfer-controller,event)` transfer result, `(grid-meter,event)` loss/restored events, `(operator-log,temperature-event)` manual log. Each tuple is a separate versioned mapping entry with only its listed kinds, values and cadence. W2-00 also reserves EV entries `(charger-controller,session-event)` for session start/end/abort and `(connector-controller,fault-event)` for fault/clear, with connector/session identity rules above; W2-05b supplies the EV pack and its own frozen mapping version. The same signal ID on a different device is not an implicit alias (`simulator/assetops_simulator/gateway/mappings.py:22-46,87-107`).
+
+## 5. W2-03 assessment, episodes and Findings
+
+Analytic IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. Input selection is accepted evidence only, fixed half-open `[from,to)`, explicit `known_at` cutoff on server `received_at`/decision time, effective Foundation/binding versions, and source gate. Include exact accepted IDs and SHA, configuration IDs, model version, window/cutoff in sorted basis SHA. A reading is usable only if GOOD, calibrated, mapped to the room, and clock-attested; SUSPECT is context. If two good primary readings disagree by >0.4°C at same timestamp, `CONTRADICTORY` and no point decision. Expected five-minute points: coverage = usable distinct scheduled timestamps / scheduled timestamps, capped at 1; `>=0.8` needed for an interval claim, but no gap >10 minutes may be bridged. Latest point must be <=10 minutes old at read time for a **current** state; historical window conclusion can remain bounded with explicit as-of. A failed worker or newer accepted relevant evidence marks prior projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new immutable revision is written.
+
+Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.
+
+Start chain groups by accepted `correlation_id`, generator asset and outage window. Require ordered grid LOST → START_REQUEST → START_RESULT → generator RUNNING/FAILED → optional TRANSFER_RESULT → bus POWERED/UNPOWERED → compressor state → probe response; tolerance is source-clock bound <=30 seconds for event ordering, with timeout from effective Foundation (default 5 minutes). A failed automatic start is `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with request, explicit failed result or timeout plus complete generator state coverage through timeout, and no contradictory success; missing request/result/state is `UNKNOWN_STEP`. A transfer-position claim requires accepted transfer event; bus energization alone proves only bus state. Cooling failure cannot be assigned from temperature alone. Emit claim levels `OBSERVED`, `BOUNDED`, `POSSIBLE`, `UNKNOWN`, `CONTRADICTORY`; explanations list exact missing/excluded records and claim ceiling.
+
+Episode key = SHA-256 of `(tenant,site,kind,subject room/generator asset,first accepted qualifying crossing/request event ID)`; retain anchor when late evidence adjusts boundaries, append `cold_episode_revision` and corresponding FindingRevision with transition `SUPPORT_CHANGED` or `BASIS_REFRESHED`. Two episodes split only after two stable in-band points (excursion) or a new start request (backup). If late evidence invalidates the anchor, append `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` and create a new episode with `split_from` relation; never rewrite old. Separate excursion and start-response Findings can cite the same event but share one `overlap_group` for money. Use existing S4-05 exact accepted-ID provenance and source classification (`backend/migrations/versions/0009_finding_store.py:33-87`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+
+## 6. W2-04 consequence, reads and UI
+
+`PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is a bounded thermal exposure indicator in `degC_min`, **not product quantity, spoilage or loss**. `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value` (currency/unit) and a product-specific reviewed `cold_exposure_rule` would be needed for a future valued risk scenario; W2 creates no default and still forbids an amount without an approved rule. `RECORDED_REPAIR` amount requires exact accepted work/cost record, currency, time and non-overlap; no such source exists in W2, so it is `UNPRICED`. All consequences pin FindingRevision, episode revision, accepted IDs, assumption revision IDs, model/formula version, source gate and overlap group. Missing/contradictory probe or policy, stale projection, mixed/unknown provenance, undeclared stock or cost → `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` with null amount. Never sum backup and excursion exposure; no zero amount as stand-in for unknown. The existing LR current-money and S4-05 source gates still apply (`backend/migrations/versions/0010_financial_assumptions.py:1-30`; `backend/migrations/versions/0011_financial_consequences.py:43-69`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).
+

Lists use opaque `(time,id)` cursor, `limit` default 50 max 200 and `{items,next_cursor}`. Shared refusal envelope `{error:{code,message}}`: 401 unauthenticated, 403 wrong tenant/source-gated disclosure, 404 Site/record not found or wrong type, 409 unresolved selected revision or recompute conflict, 422 malformed/window/range/unknown parameter, 503 ledger/projection unavailable; a valid missing claim returns 200 with `UNKNOWN`/null, never 404 or a fabricated zero. Existing evidence/Finding paths continue to serve exact links (`backend/assetops_backend/evidence_api.py:157-161`; `backend/assetops_backend/finding_api.py:102-189`).
